resources.string: The suggestion removes text or punctuation. Compare it with the original.
Download the Android AI model with an internet connection. After that, you can proofread on your device while offline.
The model is downloading. Check again in a moment.
The model could not be downloaded. Check your internet connection and try again.
Proofreading is unavailable on this device right now. If your device supports Android AICore, update it and check again.
This text block is too long. Split it into shorter blocks and try again.
The suggested correction could not be read. Try again.
Proofreading could not finish. Try again.
This text block changed. Close this sheet and proofread the updated text.
Local AI is selected. Proofreading runs on this device.
When you tap Proofread, the app sends that paragraph to OpenAI using your API key. Requests use your API credits or billing.
An API key is saved on this device.
Paste an OpenAI API key starting with sk-.
Could not update the API key on this device.
Add your OpenAI API key under Settings → Proofreading.
The saved API key could not be read. Replace it under Settings → Proofreading.
Check or replace your API key under Settings → Proofreading and verify that the key can use the OpenAI API.
Could not reach OpenAI. Check your internet connection and try again.
OpenAI rejected the request due to a rate or usage limit. Try again later or check your API credits.
OpenAI could not complete proofreading. Try again.
